rows.note: Use 阿姨 as the all-purpose choice when the aunt’s exact family relationship is unknown or not being specified.

example.english: I can't remember what that aunt's name is.
example.traditional: 我唔記得嗰位阿姨叫咩名。
example.jyutping: ngo5 m4 gei3 dak1 go2 wai2 aa3 ji4 giu3 me1 meng2

rows.note: Use 姑媽 for one’s father’s sister, especially when distinguishing her from a maternal aunt.

example.jyutping: ngo5 gu1 maa1 zyu6 hai2 wan1 go1 waa4

rows.note: Use 姨媽 for one’s mother’s sister rather than a paternal aunt.

example.english: My aunt comes back to Hong Kong every year for New Year.
example.traditional: 我姨媽每年都返香港過年。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ji4 maa1 mui5 nin4 dou1 faan1 hoeng1 gong2 gwo3 nin4

rows.note: Use 阿嬸 for an aunt by marriage who is the wife of one’s father’s younger brother.

example.english: My younger paternal uncle and aunt live in Tuen Mun.
example.traditional: 我細叔同阿嬸住喺屯門。
example.jyutping: ngo5 sai3 suk1 tung4 aa3 sam2 zyu6 hai2 tyun4 mun4
